_comment: Providers are matched in order; first whose `models` glob matches the request's model wins. Specific patterns MUST come before the "*" catch-all.

providers.name: local
providers._context: SAFE DEFAULT, deliberately not the largest window on the box. A provider-level window is a lie for tags that do not share it, so an unlisted model inherits 32768 - 8192 = 24576 and a tag added later can never be advertised more context than it actually has. Measured 2026-09-17: only qwen38-coder:q4-128k is 131072; qwen38-coder:q4 pins 32768; gemma3:1b, gemma4:e2b, qwen3.8:27b-q4_K_M and hermes-genesis:apex-compact carry no num_ctx at all and run at the server's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, 32768.
providers._model_windows: Opt-in overrides for the models that really are bigger. The 128K tag also needs the larger reserve: Claude Code asks for max_tokens=32000, and the backend window covers prompt + completion.
